text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
In the lead is Narita, Narita, Narita!
Narita Brian crosses the finish line now!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOO--!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Screams and joyous cheers shook the venue.
Even though it was only the first leg of the Classic Triple Crown,
an extraordinary level of feverish excitement hung in the air.

text_block_list.name: Mid-Level Trainer
text_block_list.text:
"...What an unbelievable Umamusume.
To think I'll have to keep facing someone like this...!"

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text: Treating everyone around her like children... She's on a completely different level...

text_block_list.name: Cameraman
text_block_list.text:
There's no doubt about it...!
That girl is going to become a Triple Crown Umamusume...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...I'll head back to the waiting room first.
choice_data_list: Yeah, leave this part to me.

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Ah, please wait!
Narita Brian-san!! At least say a word!

text_block_list.name: Cameraman
text_block_list.text:
"H-Hey!
Just one! Just let me have one photo~~!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Buzz, chatter, murmur, murmur...)

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Heh.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Unable to cause a scene in the underground tunnel,
I continued dealing with the press in the entrance lobby, but...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I should hurry to the waiting room where Narita Brian is.
She'll want to discuss what's next, too.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: "Hey, did you see that? She was a straight-up monster on that final stretch."

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
It's Brian, right? Wonder if she's running in the Derby too.
I just got in touch with my Trainer to ask about that.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A & Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: Haaah... Narita Brian, huh...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...It seems today's race shocked not just
the spectators and reporters, but everyone present.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Too slow.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Tsk. It's not like I wanted an apology.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"There isn't much time until the next race, the Tokyo Yushun (Japanese Derby).
Say what you have to say, quickly."

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"Will you be able to compete again
with those who ran in this Satsuki Sho?"
choice_data_list: Do you want to compete again?
Did you feel like competing again?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Ha, what are you saying?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Naturally. No matter what anyone says, during that race,
not a single soul was looking down.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
No one except those who stood on the turf could ever understand that exhilaration.
This is the Classic Triple Crown... A contest among peers of the same generation.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I retract my statement from before the race.
I intend to enjoy this year to the absolute fullest.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Back then, I felt Narita Brian possessed a level of fiery passion completely different from those around her.
